Hi Monica,

Thanks for taking this — both Acme's analytics team and a small group from NovaCorp are interested in a joint demo to compare how Redwood could support our multi-tenant inference needs. We're trying to consolidate two separate requests into a single session so engineering + product leads can join together.

High-level ask: a 45-minute technical walkthrough focused on latency/cost controls, Dedicated capacity options, and private deployment features. Prefer the walkthrough to include brief Q&A and a short shared runbook outline.

Potential windows (all times ET):
- Tue Nov 10, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Nov 11, 16:00–16:45
- Thu Nov 12, 09:00–09:45

If none of those work, a late-afternoon PT window on Nov 10 (17:30 PT) would work for some Pacific folks. We may have 8–12 attendees total across both companies.

Could you propose a consolidated slot and let us know capacity/bridge options if there's overflow? Also please include an agenda and any pre-reads.

Appreciate it —
Jordan

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to run a single, consolidated session for both teams. A few quick notes and options:

1) Capacity & bridge: we can host a single 45-minute session for up to 12 live participants on our standard Zoom bridge. If you expect more than 12, we will open a standby bridge and stream; we can also run two parallel breakout rooms with duplicate demos (we'll staff an extra host). Both are fine — tell me headcount preference.

2) Suggested consolidated slots (I converted to ET/PT):
- Tue Nov 10, 10:00–10:45 ET (7:00–7:45 PT) — morning ET focus
- Wed Nov 11, 16:00–16:45 ET (13:00–13:45 PT) — late afternoon ET
- Thu Nov 12, 09:00–09:45 ET (6:00–6:45 PT) — early ET; may be tight for West Coast
- Alternate: Tue Nov 10, 17:30 PT (20:30 ET) — evening ET option if you need west-coast heavy attendance

3) Hosts & backup: Marcus will join as backup host for scaling to parallel rooms and handling deep infra questions. We'll include a short runbook PDF and a one-page agenda (attached).

4) Ask from you: attendee list with role (eng/product/security) and permission to send calendar invites to the list. If you have a preferred meeting platform (Zoom/Teams), tell us and we'll use it.

I've attached the draft agenda and a 1-page pre-read. If you confirm a slot I'll send calendar invites + bridge details and a short calendar-friendly agenda.

Attachments: acme-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

+1 on the consolidated session. A couple of operational clarifications from infra:
- We typically staff 1 host + 1 backup for up to 20 attendees; for >20 we recommend a standby stream and a second host to handle breakout Q&A.
- If you expect folks to test live inference during the session (bring-your-own prompts), please let us know so we can provision a small Dedicated pool for the demo (reduces cold-start and KV cache noise).
- Fallback plan: if the shared slot fills and you need extra capacity we can queue attendees to a short follow-up office-hours slot within 48h; we can capture prompts/issues in a shared doc.

I'll be on the call and can run the Dedicated/Hosted comparison section. Also happy to prepare a short cost/perf slide for the Q&A.

Marcus
